claims.quote: These snails originate in South America: Argentina (provinces of Formosa, Chaco, Corrientes); southern Brazil (Rio Grande do Sul, Mato Grosso); Bolivia (Santa Cruz de la Sierra department, Chiquitos province); Paraguay (Alto Paraná, Itapuá, Ñeembucú departments); Uruguay (Cerro Largo department); Peru: known for the Amazon.
